title: Open Enrollment Starts Nov 1
body: Benefits open enrollment begins November 1. Review your health, dental, and vision plans before the deadline.

title: Office Closed Sept 7 for Labor Day
body: All offices will be closed on Monday, September 7 in observance of Labor Day.

title: New Wellness Reimbursement Program
body: Employees can now claim up to $300/year for gym memberships and wellness apps. See the Policies tab for details.

title: Q3 Town Hall Recording Available
body: Missed the town hall? The recording and slides are now available on the internal portal.
